cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(elfnotes_ygoenv LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter Development REQUIRED)
find_package(pybind11 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Lua 5.4 REQUIRED)
find_package(glog REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(SQLITECPP_INTERNAL_SQLITE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SQLITECPP_RUN_CPPLINT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SQLITECPP_RUN_CPPCHECK OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FMT_DOC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FMT_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(sqlitecpp)
add_subdirectory(fmt)
file(GLOB CORE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS core/*.cpp)
add_library(ocgcore STATIC ${CORE_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(ocgcore PUBLIC core ${LUA_INCLUDE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(ocgcore PUBLIC ${LUA_LIBRARIES})
pybind11_add_module(ygopro_ygoenv NO_EXTRAS agent/ygoenv/ygoenv/ygopro/ygopro.cpp)
target_include_directories(ygopro_ygoenv PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} agent/ygoenv include
    unordered-dense/include /usr/include/concurrentqueue)
target_link_libraries(ygopro_ygoenv PRIVATE ocgcore SQLiteCpp fmt::fmt glog::glog Threads::Threads)
set_target_properties(ygopro_ygoenv PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/agent/ygoenv/ygoenv/ygopro")
